name: What is the difference between a tank and tankless water heater, and which is better for my home?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a tank and tankless water heater, and which is better for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tank water heaters store and pre-heat a set volume of water, offering a ready supply but can run out during high demand. Tankless water heaters heat water on demand, providing a continuous supply, and are generally more energy-efficient in the long run. The 'better' option depends on your household's hot water usage, available space, and budget. Tankless units typically have a higher upfront cost but can offer energy savings and a longer lifespan, while tank units are generally less expensive to install.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tank heaters store hot water; tankless heat on demand. Tankless offers continuous hot water and efficiency but costs more upfront. Choose based on usage and budget.
